rationale.campaign_length: 25项混眼专属及若干兽人共通定义，形成后另换树。
rationale.colonization: 东坎诺定居重要但不是海外殖民。
rationale.complexity: 改革、半兽人人口与形成国条件相互衔接。
rationale.dark_story: 复仇与绿潮遗产构成阴影，但整体路线趋向平等。
rationale.difficulty: 战争和改革反弹需并行处理，未做实机测评。
rationale.diplomacy: 任务叙事重视谈判与跨族群关系。
rationale.early_pressure: 起点周围存在多股争地势力。
rationale.magic_artifice_intensity: 萨满与混眼圣物重要但非全局施法循环。
rationale.narrative_density: 格拉玛、阿罗莎和乌戈达沃尔串成继承故事。
rationale.tall_play: 炽热要塞与城市制度是专属任务枢纽。
rationale.trade_economy: 城市化产生经济治理主题。
rationale.warfare: 开局需对抗周边氏族与人类国家。

identity.appearance: 1444绿兽人部落；格拉玛统治，阿罗莎路线属于后续任务
identity.formation_scope: 可按通用兽人决议形成乌戈达沃尔Z52；曾为B24者有专属延续条件，不是独占形成入口

national_ideas.scope_note: 国家传统、七项国家理念与野心；不含可选理念组、种族/政府加成。多套候选与条件分别列示，不视为同时叠加；形成时是否接受新理念由实际事件/决议与玩家选择决定。

description.text: 世世代代，我们睿智的萨满巫师都在一个古老的、被称为「混眼试炼」部族仪式中牺牲了自己的视觉，但这一切都是为了追求杜坎的智慧。这个仪式非常危险，但幸存下来的萨满会发现自己与萨满魔法更加契合。少数有资格的人甚至可以使用「混眼」，这是一种神秘之物，由一块未经切割的纯白色水晶组成「混眼」是我们部族长期守护的宝物，据说是杜坎直接赐予的，甚至可能是锁链之神本人的眼睛。它能带来对未来的美好憧憬和对过去传说的详细洞察，还有什么其他的来历呢？
description.text_en: For generations our sagely shamans have sacrificed their very vision in an ancient clan ritual known as "The Trial of Clouded", all in the pursuit of Dookan’s wisdom. The ritual is a dangerous one, but those who survive find themselves better attuned with shamanic magics. A worthy few may even wield "The Clouded Eye", a mystical object consisting of a rough uncut gem of pure glowing white crystal. A treasure our clan has long guarded, the Eye is believed to have been gifted directly from Dookan and may even be the eye of the chained god himself. With the power to bestow great visions of a possible future and detail insights on the lore of the past, what other origin could there be?

description.text: 其他部族可能会歌颂勇敢而强大的首领，而我们却崇尚智慧和聪明；我们的传奇首领格拉玛最能体现这一点。正是她对外面青翠土地的预言，让我们团结在科尔古斯的身后，成为他最早也是最狂热的追随者之一。当绿潮从卡斯泰利尔席卷至法拉内安，将古老的东坎诺王国四分五裂时，是她的巧舌如簧解决了部族之间的纷争。正是她在血腐阶梯的诡计，让阿德蕾西娅骑士在我们萨满的威力下溃不成军。当杜坎森倒下时，是她带领我们来到了富饶的黄丘，在那里，我们的人民可以实现她多年前的愿景。即使在她咽下最后一口气之后，我们也知道，她的教诲将指引我们走向新的未来。
description.text_en: While other clans may sing of bold and mighty warchiefs, we instead honor the wise and clever; none other embodies this better than our legendary chieftain, Grama. It was her prophetic dream of the verdant lands outside that led us to rally behind Korgus as one of his first and most fervent followers. It was her clever tongue that settled disputes between the clans as the Greentide swept from Castellyr to Farranaen, carving apart the old kingdoms of Escann. It was her guile at Rottenstep that left the Aldresians decimated under the might of our shamans. And when The Dookanson fell, it was she who led us to the rich hills of Gulenhyl where our people may bring life to the vision she had so many years ago. Even after she draws her final breath, we know that it will be her teachings that will guide us toward our new future.

description.text:
随着挚爱的格拉玛的去世，以及冒险者们日益增长的压力，我们的预言家们拼命地在部族中寻找一位领袖，一位能够带领我们走向荣耀，并团结被杜坎陨落撕裂的部族的新首领。然而，当我们占卜出最凶猛的战士和最睿智的萨满的命运时，绝望开始降临。每一个兽人，从格拉玛的后裔到经验丰富的绿潮老兵，都注定要被冒险者的利刃或奴隶主的锁链所终结。

然后，她来了。

身着与冒险者敌人相似的盔甲，手持强大的斧头，失宠的阿罗莎·伐橡者来到了混眼，引起了一阵骚动。阿罗莎让所有向她挑战的战士匍匐在地，然后向我们部族的萨满们发出了呼唤。随着一声怒吼，这位勇士说出了她在流放过程中学到的经验。这些教训来自她曾经的同伴科琳·科尔古斯杀手。责任和怜悯成就了力量和荣誉。

阿罗莎·伐橡者说完后，聚集在一起的萨满们一开始并没有回应。他们也没有试图用魔法占卜或召唤混眼。相反，他们跪了下来。格拉玛死后，未来第一次变得清晰起来。混眼酋长阿罗莎·伐橡者的时代即将到来。
description.text_en:
With the death of beloved Grama and the increasing pressure faced from the adventurer onslaught, our seers desperately scoured our clan for a leader, a new warchief who could lead us to glory and unite the clans torn asunder by Dookansfall. Yet as we divined the fates of our fiercest warriors and wisest shamans, despair began to set in. Every orc, from the descendants of Grama herself to the seasoned veterans of the Greentide, was doomed to meet their end by the adventurer's blade or by the slaver's chain.

Then she came.

 Clad in the armor reminiscent of our adventurer foes and mighty axe in hand, Arosha of the disgraced Oakbreakers would arrive in Clouded Eye to much commotion. After leaving any warrior who challenged her sprawled on the ground, Arosha called out to the shamans of our clan. With a bellow, the warrior gave voice to the lessons learned in her exile. Lessons from her once companion, Corin Korguskiller. That strength and honor were made whole by duty and compassion.

When Arosha had finished, the gathered shamans did not respond at first. Nor did they attempt to divine with magic or invoke the Clouded Eye. Instead, they kneeled. For the first time since Grama’s death, the future was clear. Ushering in the era of Arosha Oakbreaker, Chieftain of Clouded Eye.

description.text:
在绿潮最终战败和科尔古斯·杜坎森死后的几十年里，东坎诺兽人将陷入一片混乱。二十年来，最终的权力都集中在科尔古斯和他与杜坎的神圣联系上。他的倒台不仅打破了兽人的团结，还在部族内部留下了权力真空，因为许多酋长都将自己的合法性与科尔古斯（以及杜坎）的意志联系在一起。

与「铁腕统治」这个成语大致相同，钢手（Tuladosh）代表了东坎诺兽人各酋长为加强对部族的控制而做出的努力。一些人试图继承科尔古斯的衣钵，以争取合法地位。其他人则致力于重建废墟，以建立信任。更多的人则试图统治当地的环境，以显示自己的实力。所有人都会发现，他们的努力都是徒劳的。
description.text_en:
The decades after the Greentide’s ultimate defeat and Korgus Dookanson’s death would be a chaotic one for the Escanni orcs. For two decades, ultimate authority had been centralised around Korgus and his divine connection to Dookan. His downfall did not simply shatter orcish unity, it left a power vacuum within the clans themselves as many chieftains had tied their own legitimacy to Korgus’ (and by extension Dookan’s) will.

Roughly equivalent to the idiom of "ruling with an iron fist", Tuladosh, or steel hand, represented the various Escanni orcish chieftains bids to assert firmer control over their clans. Some would attempt to take up Korgus’ fallen mantle in a bid for legitimacy. Others would focus their efforts on rebuilding the ruined land to build trust. More still would settle for trying to dominate the local surroundings to show their strength. All would find their efforts a struggle.

description.text:
随着绿皮兽人从征服者转变为居民，在各个新生王国中形成了两个阶级——达戈姆和奥萨丹。达戈姆居住在重建的小村庄和城镇中，代表着兽人社会的演变。

达戈姆由手工业者、商人和其他城市角色组成，他们来自于那些已经拥有巨大财富和权力的人，或者那些认识到手工业和商业所能带来的力量的人。通过这些手段，达戈姆将成为新生官僚机构的基础，并控制国家的大部分财富。

另一方面，奥萨丹代表着不变的兽人传统。奥萨丹主要是旅行的战士和迁徙的牧民，他们要么太穷（要么太固执）而无法定居，奥萨丹酣畅淋漓的生活方式意味着他们是王国防御的天然后备力量。虽然他们能力出众，但他们对传统习俗的恪守始终令中央政府头疼不已。
description.text_en:
As the Green Orcs transitioned from conquerors to inhabitants, two classes would come to form within the various nascent kingdoms - the Dargom and Ozdan. Residing within the rebuilt hamlets and refounded towns, the Dargom represented the evolution of orcish society.

Dominated by craftspeople, merchants and other urban roles, the Dargom stemmed from those who already held great wealth and power or recognized the power that could come from craftsmanship and commerce. Through these means, the Dargom would form the basis of the nascent bureaucracy and come to control much of the state’s wealth.

The Ozdan, on the other hand, represented unchanging orcish tradition. Dominated by travelling warriors and migratory herders who were either too poor (or too stubborn) to settle, the Ozdan’s hearty lifestyle meant they were a natural pool to draw on for the kingdom’s defence. While capable, their adherence to the old ways would lead constant headaches to the central government

description.text:
随着土地争夺战持续到16世纪，东坎诺兽人与其他种族之间的仇恨将世代相传，但旧日的仇恨最终将让位于冷酷的功利主义。

预示着这一演变的是深红洪水，一场看似神圣的大灾难让东坎诺血流成河。随着这些非自然事件的发生，商业也受到了干扰，动荡的天气开始夺走东坎诺的商队。经济危机开始酝酿，兽人王国开始介入。兽人比一般人类强壮，又是天生的探路者，他们更有能力抵御险恶的降雨及其带来的暴力。虽然最初遭到了拒绝，但坎诺的商人们发现自己更愿意睁一只眼闭一只眼，只要能赚到钱，他们就会允许兽人在这些险恶的道路上跋涉。
description.text_en:
While the animosity between the orcs of Escann and the other races would last generations as the struggle for land continued into the 16th century, old hatred would eventually give way to cold utilitarianism.

Heralding this evolution would be the Crimson Deluge, a seemingly divine cataclysm that showered Escann with blood and gore. With these unnatural events came disruptions to commerce as tumultuous weather began to claim Escanni caravans. As an economic crisis began to brew, it would be the orcish kingdoms who would step in. Orcs, stronger than the average human and born wayfinders, were more capable of withstanding the treacherous rains and the violence it wrought. While initially rejected, the merchants of Cannor found themselves more willing to look the other way and allow orcs to trek these treacherous routes as long as the coin flowed.

description.text:
无论冒险者王国和兽人王国之间出现了怎样的平衡，当第一代巫师王出现时，这种平衡都将戛然而止。兽人王国在劳伦斯·西尔·普莱斯和双足飞龙之心摄政王这样的法师面前束手无策。面对这样的敌人，即使是最强大的萨满也会化为灰烬，显然必须采取新的战术。

这就是萨加达姆，或称影枪。这些战士利用他们的皮肤在东坎诺绿色植物中的天然伪装优势，依靠伏击战术来抑制和阻击对兽人更加肆无忌惮的进攻。当这些勇敢的兽人为保护自己的家园而战的时候，有些人不禁觉得讽刺，正是他们现在正被不可阻挡的浪潮席卷着......
description.text_en:
Whatever equilibrium that arose between the adventurer kingdoms and orcish kingdoms would come to a violent end when the first witch kings arose. Armies onto themselves, the orcish kingdoms buckled under the likes of mages like Laurens síl Place and the Regent of Wyvernheart. When even the most powerful shamans were reduced to dust in the face of such foes, it was clear new tactics had to be adopted.

What came about was the sagah’dams, or shadowshots. Taking advantage of their skin’s natural camouflage in the greenery of Escann, these warriors would rely on ambush tactics to inhibit and blunt ever more brazen advances into orcish land. As these brave orcs fought to preserve their home, some could not help but find it ironic it was they who were now being swept away by some unstoppable tide…

Dominated by craftspeople, merchants and other urban roles, the Dargom stemmed from those who already held great wealth and power or recognized the power that could come from craftsmanship and commerce. Through these means, the Dargom would form the basis of the nascent bureaucracy and come to control much of the state’s wealth.

The Ozdan, on the other hand, represented unchanging orcish tradition. Dominated by travelling warriors and migratory herders who were either too poor (or too stubborn) to settle, the Ozdan’s hearty lifestyle meant they were a natural pool to draw on for the kingdom’s defence. While capable, their adherence to the old ways would lead constant headaches to the central government

description.text:
随着土地争夺战持续到16世纪，东坎诺兽人与其他种族之间的仇恨将世代相传，但旧日的仇恨最终将让位于冷酷的功利主义。

预示着这一演变的是深红洪水，一场看似神圣的大灾难让东坎诺血流成河。随着这些非自然事件的发生，商业也受到了干扰，动荡的天气开始夺走东坎诺的商队。经济危机开始酝酿，兽人王国开始介入。兽人比一般人类强壮，又是天生的探路者，他们更有能力抵御险恶的降雨及其带来的暴力。虽然最初遭到了拒绝，但坎诺的商人们发现自己更愿意睁一只眼闭一只眼，只要能赚到钱，他们就会允许兽人在这些险恶的道路上跋涉。
description.text_en:
While the animosity between the orcs of Escann and the other races would last generations as the struggle for land continued into the 16th century, old hatred would eventually give way to cold utilitarianism.

Heralding this evolution would be the Crimson Deluge, a seemingly divine cataclysm that showered Escann with blood and gore. With these unnatural events came disruptions to commerce as tumultuous weather began to claim Escanni caravans. As an economic crisis began to brew, it would be the orcish kingdoms who would step in. Orcs, stronger than the average human and born wayfinders, were more capable of withstanding the treacherous rains and the violence it wrought. While initially rejected, the merchants of Cannor found themselves more willing to look the other way and allow orcs to trek these treacherous routes as long as the coin flowed.

description.text:
无论冒险者王国和兽人王国之间出现了怎样的平衡，当第一代巫师王出现时，这种平衡都将戛然而止。兽人王国在劳伦斯·西尔·普莱斯和双足飞龙之心摄政王这样的法师面前束手无策。面对这样的敌人，即使是最强大的萨满也会化为灰烬，显然必须采取新的战术。

这就是萨加达姆，或称影枪。这些战士利用他们的皮肤在东坎诺绿色植物中的天然伪装优势，依靠伏击战术来抑制和阻击对兽人更加肆无忌惮的进攻。当这些勇敢的兽人为保护自己的家园而战的时候，有些人不禁觉得讽刺，正是他们现在正被不可阻挡的浪潮席卷着......
description.text_en:
Whatever equilibrium that arose between the adventurer kingdoms and orcish kingdoms would come to a violent end when the first witch kings arose. Armies onto themselves, the orcish kingdoms buckled under the likes of mages like Laurens síl Place and the Regent of Wyvernheart. When even the most powerful shamans were reduced to dust in the face of such foes, it was clear new tactics had to be adopted.

What came about was the sagah’dams, or shadowshots. Taking advantage of their skin’s natural camouflage in the greenery of Escann, these warriors would rely on ambush tactics to inhibit and blunt ever more brazen advances into orcish land. As these brave orcs fought to preserve their home, some could not help but find it ironic it was they who were now being swept away by some unstoppable tide…

player_overview.avoid_if: 只想无脑掠夺、对城市建设和改革叛乱没有耐心的玩家。
player_overview.how_it_plays: 先夺取立足点和炽热要塞，再经营城市、半兽人人口与改革，最后选择形成乌戈达沃尔并处理氏族反弹。
player_overview.overview: 你从格拉玛统治的兽人萨满氏族起步，在东坎诺与旧敌争地，也要证明兽人能靠谋略、谈判和制度生存。阿罗莎的路线会把氏族带向炽热要塞、城市建设与跨族群社会；改革越深入，旧部落反弹也越明显。最终可以与其他兽人共同建立乌戈达沃尔，但那是玩家要争取的未来，不是开局现状。
player_overview.recommended_for: 喜欢兽人重建、多族群国家和从部落到王国的连续故事的玩家。
signature_features: 格拉玛与阿罗莎的传承让兽人战役成为一段改革故事。
炽热要塞、半兽人共同体和达戈姆政治把征服转为城市治理。
通用乌戈达沃尔形成国为混眼保留曾用Tag的后续内容。
player_overview.tagline: 把绿潮余部带出掠夺时代，为兽人、半兽人和人类建一座共同的城。

reasons: 兽人改革与半兽人平等社会有清晰转折
城市建设与部落战争并行
形成乌戈达沃尔后保留混眼身份延续
warnings: 早期炽热要塞可能被邻国先占
改革路线伴随旧氏族反弹

positive_indicators: 任务明确书写兽人与人类平等
半兽人不再被当作非人格者
城市、官僚与更安全的军事制度服务居民
values.rationale: 半兽人与人类平等共居、减少战士无谓死亡及建设城市具有强正面证据；对碎剑者复仇和改革镇压降低克制。战争与兽人身份本身不参与善恶评分。
red_flags: 对碎剑者的复仇文本带有毁灭性语言
达戈姆改革会激起旧氏族反抗
